question: Who among the following personalities along with his sons played ‘Raga for Peace’ in the year 2014 at the ‘Nobel Peace Prize Concert’?

options.text:
Ustad Bismillah Khan

×

solution:
The correct answer is** __Ustad Amjad Ali Khan__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amjad Ali, Amaan, and Ayaan** took to the staging post the felicitation of Malala and Satyarthi to perform their** ' Raga For Peace'. **
 
• The Nobel Peace Prize is one of the** five Nobel Prizes established** by the will of **Swedish industrialists, inventors, and armaments Manufacturer Alfred Nobel, along with the prizes in Chemistry, Physics, Physiology or Medicine and Literature.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan**, often referred to by the title Ustad, was an Indian musician credited with **popularizing the shehnai.**
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan** is an Indian musician who** popularised the bowed instrument sarangi.**
 
• **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia** is an Indian music director and classical flutist, who plays the flute.
